attempts.sql: SELECT ups.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.untested_public_symbols ups JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols s ON ups.symbol_id = s.symbol_id WHERE s.is_public = TRUE AND ups.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND NOT ups.file_id LIKE '%tests%' GROUP BY ups.kind ORDER BY ups.kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public code entities (classes, functions, methods) in the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package, excluding test files, grouped by kind. It joins the untested_public_symbols table with symbols on symbol_id to apply the is_public filter (name not starting with underscore), filters file paths to the kumo package while rejecting any containing 'tests', then aggregates public symbol counts per kind kind and orders the results alphabetically by kind.
sql: SELECT ups.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.untested_public_symbols ups JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols s ON ups.symbol_id = s.symbol_id WHERE s.is_public = TRUE AND ups.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND NOT ups.file_id LIKE '%tests%' GROUP BY ups.kind ORDER BY ups.kind
